You: Oh look! That lady in the changing room is crouching right now and you can totally see her bare butt under the curtain!
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Where?! Which changing room dammit?!
#Annalie.Face.shocked
You: Got you. There are only the two of us here, dummy. 
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: No bullying, ok? Why do you have to be like that? Playing with a woman's heart…
You: Haha, don’t take it personally, ok? 
You: How about you help me choose something to buy so we can make up?
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Sure thing!
